description: Exactly ONE compact horizontal pixel art boss-presence HUD FRAME, 256x64 pixels. Follow the concept image layout and outer panel proportions closely. Fishing from a weathered boat beneath a violet sky rift. Dark gunmetal and aged bronze riveted ship fittings frame the rim. Thin glowing violet cracks across the outer corners, small sea-wave curls and a tiny rope knot. Dramatic but cozy, not modern neon sci-fi. Keep a generous 48-pixel-high rectangular interior; never compress it to a thin health bar. The reference fish, if present, is only a palette and motif reference: leave the left badge interior EMPTY for an existing sprite. Match this usable layout: outer border entirely within x2..253,y2..61; thick ornamental rim only at edges; empty dark left badge x10..47,y11..52; large blank dark LABEL AREA x54..242,y11..32; separate empty black PROGRESS TROUGH x54..242,y39..49. The label area must be visibly taller than the trough. Do not fill the trough. Every inner area stays dark, blank, simple and unobstructed. Decorate only the outer rim with the region motifs. Crisp square pixels, strong dark outline, three shades per material, cozy detailed 16-bit fishing RPG. All four edges and corner ornaments fully visible, transparent exterior. No text, no letters, no numerals, no glyphs, no tick marks, no filled progress, no fish body, no people, no background scene, no blurred gradients. One frame only.
color_palette: gunmetal navy, weathered bronze, muted warm wood, violet rift light
